text:
Sam PM: FYI — AcmePayments sent beta asks. They need 90d trace retention, per-route sampling controls, and searchable export (S3) for audits. I put a short PRD draft here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-453 (please read). Need alignment on launch criteria + scope tradeoffs.

Anya Design: Seen the doc. I did quick mocks for a retention panel and an export modal — Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/obs-retention. Key UX ask: customer wants one-click export and an in-console indicator that 30d vs 90d affects search availability.

Matt Eng: Quick infra note — 90d hot retention at Acme volume (~500k traces/day) means ~2-3x storage and query cost. Suggest MVP: 30d hot in-console + automated cold export to S3 for >30d. Per-route sampling is doable but will need a config surface and runtime switch.

Jun SRE: Agree with Matt. Also need TTL compaction and cold-read flow. Cold reads -> S3 retrieval + reindex step will add minutes to hours. We should define SLA expectations. Load tests required before rolling to prod.

Kai CS: Acme explicitly said: "searchable in-console for 90d is a blocker for compliance audits" — they are willing to accept an exported archive only if console can surface results seamlessly. They asked about: aggregated search across hot+archived traces.

Sam PM: Options on the table: A) MVP (lower risk): 30d in-console + one-click export + documented search script + support-assisted retrieval. B) Full (higher cost): 90d fully searchable in-console. Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- AC1: Customer can enable per-organization retention with choices 30d/90d. (MVP: UI shows 90d but points to export flow)
- AC2: Per-route sampling control visible in route config; accepts `sampling: {type: 'fixed'|'adaptive', rate: float}`.
- AC3: Export to S3 runs reliably and a history of export jobs is shown in UI.
- AC4: Load tests validate ingestion at 3x expected and queries for recent 7d < 5s. Cold retrieval documented.

Anya Design: Edge cases to call out:
- If export fails mid-run, UI must surface partial export and allow retry.
- If per-route sampling toggled to higher rate, show cost delta tooltip.
- If org enables 90d but doesn't provide S3 credentials, we show onboarding flow and a "request assistance" CTA.

Matt Eng: Implementation notes: we add a per-route config entry like:
```json
"sampling": {"type": "fixed", "rate": 0.01}
```
Runtime will honor sampling at the router before write. For 90d in-console we'd need a cold-store query path and either reindexing or on-demand retrieval to a queryable cache — significant engineering work.

Jun SRE: Suggested acceptance tests to include in PRD:
- Ingest 3x projected peak for 72h with retention enabled.
- Query latency: recent 7d <= 5s P95; archived retrieval <= 60s for single trace metadata and minutes for full payloads.
- Export test: interrupt export and verify retry/resume works and UI shows partial state.

Kai CS: Customer timeline: they want beta by May 15 to align with an audit window. Willing to take MVP if we provide a documented retrieval workflow and a joint runbook.

Sam PM: Engineering estimates? Matt, is May 15 realistic for MVP A (30d + export + sampling UI)?

Matt Eng: Tight but possible if we scope strictly: backend export + UI + sampling config + job history. No full in-console 90d search. I'd estimate 3 sprints (including one for load testing and SRE signoff). So late May is optimistic; mid-June is safe.

Kai CS: Proposed customer messaging: offer interim beta with export + support for retrieval. Ask Acme to try MVP and sign off on delayed full 90d search. I'll get written confirmation and push an acceptance doc.

Sam PM: Agreement: ship MVP A for beta. Action items:
1) Matt Eng: provide story point estimate + infra cost delta to support 30d->90d (ETA EOD today).
2) Jun SRE: write load test plan + success criteria (ETA EOD today).
3) Anya Design: finalize mocks and cost tooltip copy (ETA tomorrow).
4) Kai CS: confirm Acme acceptance of MVP A and share exact audit requirements (ETA EOD).
5) Sam PM: update PRD with selected ACs and timeline, link back to this thread.

Matt Eng: I'll post a short RFC with rollout steps and canary config later today.

Anya Design: :thumbsup: I'll add the partial-export modal state and the "cost projection" microcopy.

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly infra budget sync in #finance tomorrow 9am PT.

Sam PM: Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT to finalize scope and confirm customer ok. Thanks all.
